accepted.A4: Closed under the stop rule agreed after five review rounds. (1) The active cell after a drag is read only where the drag ends on the rectangle's bottom-right corner (D6, D4), so a bottom-right rule passes; a follow-up will read tabindex after the D6-to-B2 drag. (2) Live feedback during a drag needs a step that holds the button, which the runner does not have.
accepted.C1: Those first steps record the starting state; the check still fails on the starter at its first click, so they cost nothing.
accepted.C2: The runner's drag step is atomic (press, moves, release) and no step holds the button, so only end states can be read. Out-and-back drags check the end state of a shrink, to the pressed cell and part of the way.
